title: Two carriers of an autosomal recessive condition
caption: Each carrier (Aa) is unaffected but passes the recessive allele a to half their gametes. In every pregnancy there is a 1 in 4 chance of an affected child (aa), a 1 in 2 chance of a carrier and a 1 in 4 chance of a child with two working copies.
alt: A Punnett square of two unaffected carrier parents: one AA, two Aa and one aa child; the aa child is affected.
description: Both parents are Aa: unaffected carriers.
Each makes A and a gametes.
The children are AA, Aa, Aa and aa.
One in four (aa) is affected; three in four are unaffected, and two of those are carriers.
